nodes.label: Policy drafts and local decision preview
nodes.norm_label: policy drafts and local decision preview
nodes.rationale: Workspace owners/admins can save validated PostgreSQL-backed drafts. Local previews do not execute tasks, verify identities, configure networks or activate agent permissions.

nodes.label: Planned protocol adapters
nodes.rationale: A2A/JSON-RPC, MCP, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS/SPIFFE, SSE/WebSocket and OpenTelemetry/W3C Trace Context are integration candidates, not implemented adapters. All must pass through the same authorization boundary.

nodes.label: Module catalog contracts and record-write audit
nodes.norm_label: module catalog contracts and record-write audit
nodes.rationale: The shared contracts package defines the module catalog. Existing role checks and hash-chained audit events apply to module record writes; this does not establish complete audit coverage or shared operational job/artifact services.

nodes.label: Platform authorization and approved agent grants
nodes.norm_label: platform authorization and approved agent grants
nodes.rationale: Web middleware and API guards protect platform requests. Physical-key WebAuthn authenticates administrators; password sessions are limited to enrollment. Membership and roles scope access; agent grants require human approval, signatures and replay nonces.

nodes.label: Running Next.js and NestJS application
nodes.rationale: Next.js exposes the public Compose entry point and forwards API, MathShield and PulseWatch routes. API, tools, PostgreSQL, Redis and storage are private services; default Docker networking still permits outbound connections.

nodes.label: Shared UI and server policy validator
nodes.norm_label: shared ui and server policy validator
nodes.rationale: AgentShield uses the same policy validator in the UI and server. Saving drafts neither activates permissions nor deploys CDN delivery or worker isolation.

nodes.label: Unfinished job, artifact, secret and connector services
nodes.norm_label: unfinished job, artifact, secret and connector services
nodes.rationale: Redis job execution, end-to-end worker dispatch, persistent artifacts, short-lived storage URLs, scoped secret delivery and external connector execution remain unfinished. The run service rejects jobs without a configured runner.

nodes.label: Unfinished production telemetry
nodes.rationale: Production telemetry is explicitly unfinished; protocol inventory and target architecture must not be described as operational tracing.

nodes.label: Workspace-scoped PostgreSQL records
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL owns workspace/project metadata and module records. Module settings govern navigation and record access; some tool state remains browser-local and full persistence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Load Lab worker execution gap
nodes.rationale: K6 script download works; private worker execution, results and trend reporting remain unfinished.

nodes.label: Outstanding platform integration
nodes.rationale: Open work includes worker dispatch, artifact persistence, RBAC/SSO/service accounts/tenant isolation, complete audit coverage, connector secrets, cloud/Kubernetes parity, search, notifications and full workflow tests. Existing role checks do not imply completion of this backlog.

nodes.label: PromptVault persistence migration
nodes.rationale: Workspace records and disabled-module API checks are tested. Version history and backup-first import preserve browser copies; browser save/import verification, team collections, branches and experiments remain open.

nodes.label: Single-port application gateway
nodes.rationale: Compose exposes one public application port while API and tool services remain private. Private Compose networking does not establish outbound internet isolation.

nodes.label: Module migration checklist
nodes.rationale: Tracks functioning shared-UI entry points separately from standalone parity. Each module needs testing through port 3000 before completion; builds and route smoke checks do not establish full workflow parity.

nodes.label: Accessible interaction and truthful data states
nodes.norm_label: accessible interaction and truthful data states
nodes.rationale: Controls require visible focus, programmatic labels and disabled write states; data surfaces must expose loading, empty, error and long-content states without demo metrics.

nodes.label: Responsive engineering console
nodes.rationale: Predictable shared navigation and contrasting navigation/work surfaces support scanning while task-specific layouts preserve each tool's editing, preview and results needs.

nodes.label: Planned task authorization gateway
nodes.rationale: The gateway must authenticate principal and workspace, bind tasks to user intent, enforce resource/action scopes and expiry, and reject unrequested delegation. Tool output is untrusted input.

nodes.label: Planned isolated agent workers
nodes.rationale: Policy must be enforced outside the agent process using deny-all networking, non-root execution, read-only filesystems, quotas and an authenticated local broker. Runtime isolation remains required work.

nodes.label: Planned per-connection network validation
nodes.rationale: Validate DNS/IP on every connection and redirect, deny private/link-local/metadata addresses, verify TLS and bound response size and time.

nodes.label: Planned tenant-partitioned public asset cache
nodes.rationale: Tenant-aware public caching requires hashes, revalidation and measured performance. Authenticated responses, secrets, model responses and mutation results must never be shared.

nodes.label: Unfinished managed CDN requirements
nodes.rationale: Managed CDN delivery needs origin ownership checks, provider integration, certificates, tenant-aware cache keys, invalidation and metrics. Shared caching is limited to public immutable assets; optimistic updates are limited to reversible configuration with rollback.

nodes.label: Target authenticated agent data path
nodes.rationale: The target path is authenticated client to policy gateway to isolated worker or approved CDN origin. Execution requires verified identity, workspace, action/resource, expiry and budget; runtime network checks prevent SSRF and DNS rebinding beyond configuration validation.

nodes.label: Explicit MinIO image compatibility
nodes.rationale: FORGEOS_MINIO_IMAGE has no default because the former floating image is unreliable and image changes could downgrade persistent storage. Inspect the existing version and back up data; the disposable CI image predates the cited security fix. A storage service does not establish completed artifact workflows.
